sig: [[["A", "Hi Jessica. The client in Chicago just emailed. They can't make the demo on Thursday."], ["B", "Oh, really? That's a shame, we were all set. Did they say why?"], ["A", "Their CEO wants to join, but she's traveling that day."], ["B", "OK, that makes sense. So when can they do it instead?"], ["A", "They suggested Friday at eight a.m., Chicago time."], ["B", "Hmm, that's nine p.m. for us. A bit late, but I can manage if it's only an hour."], ["A", "Me too. I'll send them a new calendar invite, then, and confirm the time on both sides."], ["B", "Great. Should we do a quick test run before the demo?"], ["A", "Good idea. How about Friday afternoon at two?"], ["B", "Works for me. I'll book a room and let the team know. We should also double-check that the demo data is up to date."]], {"A": "M-AU", "B": "F-US"}]
